messages:
sam: Quick shepherding nudge — ran a quicklink scan against /runtime and /runtime/api tonight. Found ~12 dead anchor fragments, 1 frontmatter slug mismatch, and 3 external S3 403s. Anyone able to pick a small bundle? :wave:
priya: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the scan output? I can take a few anchors if they're trivial.
sam: Pasted below. Most anchors are in runtime/llm-cache.md and runtime/onboarding-snippets.md. Frontmatter slug is a weird trailing space in runtime/guide.md. S3 403s point to old gist-hosted images.
docscan-bot: scan run: 2026-03-23T02:18Z; path:/runtime; dead_anchors:12; externals:3(HTTP403); frontmatter_issues:1; sample_line: "[See cache behaviour](#kv-cache-behaviour )"
elaine: I'll take runtime/llm-cache.md anchors (3 of them). Will open a micro-PR and add a changelog entry in the PR body. ETA today EOD PST.
noah: I'll handle the S3 403s — looks like those images are from an archived partner gist. Plan: rehost to internal CDN and update links. Will need a quick access from infra to publish; @priya can you confirm CDN path?
priya: Yep — use https://cdn.redwood-inference.internal/assets/docs-temp/ for rehost. Please prefix with /runtime/ for consistency. I'll add a short IAM note in the PR.
sam: Thanks y'all. For the slug mismatch: it's literally an extra trailing space in the frontmatter title/slug. Quick sed to fix: 
```
# from repo root
sed -i 's/slug: "runtime-guide "/slug: "runtime-guide"/' content/runtime/guide.md
git add -A && git commit -m "fix(frontmatter): trim trailing space on runtime-guide slug"
```
elaine: re anchors — a couple are just old fragment ids moved to headings. I'll convert those to stable shortlink references (use page anchors or link to section IDs). Will mention in PR description which fragments I updated.
noah: For the rehost, heads-up: change will touch 3 docs (runtime/onboarding-snippets.md, runtime/guide.md, runtime/api-images.md). I'll add a note to the PR describing original URL -> CDN mapping.
priya: If anyone needs a reviewer for quick CRs, ping me and I can do a fast pass this afternoon. Also, small ask: can we add a tiny test in the docs CI to fail on trailing-space slugs? Could save future churn.
sam: +1 on the CI hook. Minimal rule: fail if frontmatter slug contains leading/trailing whitespace. I can open that as a follow-up RFC PR unless someone wants to take it.
elaine: I'll include a link to the scan in my PR and mark it "docs: anchors audit". Prefer to squash and merge since changes are mechanical.
noah: I'll open PR titled "fix(docs): rehost external images and update S3 refs" and link infra ticket if needed. ETA tomorrow morning.
priya: Thanks — once PRs are up, post here and I'll assign quick reviewers. :thumbsup:
sam: Awesome. If anyone wants to split the 12 anchors into smaller bites, here's my proposed assignment: elaine 3, priya 4, sam 3 (I can take the remaining), noah 2 for cross-check. If that sounds good I'll mark them in the tracker.
elaine: sounds good. I'll update tracker and add the PR link when ready.
priya: ping @docscan-bot to re-run scan after merges?
docscan-bot: acknowledged. Scheduling re-scan in 24h after all linked PRs merged. :robot_face:
sam: cool — thanks folks. leaving this thread open for PR links and quick CR pings.
notes: micro-coordination, anchor fixes, frontmatter slug trim, rehost externals; CI suggestion; follow-ups assigned
